name: tools
description: 本地优先的图片、文档、表格与文件批处理桌面工作台
author: jdassd <jdassd@163.com>

scripts.init: pnpm run clean && pnpm install && pnpm run initInstall && pnpm run prepare:flyingmouse
scripts.initCiComments: CI 专用精简初始化：跳过 clean 与 LibreOffice，默认 PyPI 源，复用 venv 缓存
scripts.initInstall:linux: pnpm run initInstallLinuxPre && pnpm -C ./gui install && python3 -m venv pyapp/pyenv && ./pyapp/pyenv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip -i https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/ && ./pyapp/pyenv/bin/pip install -i https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/ -r ./pyapp/requirements.txt && ./pyapp/pyenv/bin/pip install -i https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/ -r ./pyapp/requirements-dev.txt && ./pyapp/pyenv/bin/python ./pyapp/package/exe/getAppISSID.py && ./pyapp/pyenv/bin/python ./pyapp/db/json/getKeyDB.py && pnpm run ensureOffice
scripts.initInstall:macos: pnpm -C ./gui install && python3 -m venv pyapp/pyenv && ./pyapp/pyenv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip -i https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/ && ./pyapp/pyenv/bin/pip install -i https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/ -r ./pyapp/requirements.txt && ./pyapp/pyenv/bin/pip install -i https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/ -r ./pyapp/requirements-dev.txt && ./pyapp/pyenv/bin/python ./pyapp/package/exe/getAppISSID.py && ./pyapp/pyenv/bin/python ./pyapp/db/json/getKeyDB.py && pnpm run ensureOffice
scripts.initInstall:windows: pnpm -C .\gui install && py -3.10 -m venv pyapp\pyenv\pyenv && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\python -m pip install --upgrade pip -i https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/ && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\pip install -i https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/ -r .\pyapp\requirements.txt && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\pip install -i https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/ -r .\pyapp\requirements-dev.txt && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\python .\pyapp\package\exe\getAppISSID.py && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\python .\pyapp\db\json\getKeyDB.py && pnpm run ensureOffice
scripts.initInstallLinuxPre: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y python3-venv python3-dev python3-gi python3-gi-cairo gir1.2-gtk-3.0 gir1.2-webkit2-4.1 gobject-introspection pkg-config libcairo2-dev libgirepository1.0-dev build-essential make dpkg-dev
scripts.ensureOfficeComments: 尽力安装 Word 按页码功能所需的 LibreOffice（可选依赖，失败不中断 init）
scripts.prepareFlyingMouseComments: 安装并暂存随 PPX 打包的 FlyingMouse Format 与平台 Node 运行时
scripts.init:cef: pnpm install && pnpm -C .\gui install && py -3.10 -m venv pyapp\pyenv\pyenvCEF && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenvCEF\Scripts\python -m pip install --upgrade pip -i https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/ && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenvCEF\Scripts\pip install -i https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/ -r .\pyapp\requirements.txt && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenvCEF\Scripts\pip install -i https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/ cefpython3 && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenvCEF\Scripts\python .\pyapp\package\exe\getAppISSID.py && pnpm run prepare:flyingmouse
scripts.mindmapComments: 思维导图前端来自同级仓库 ../mind-map（MindMapJdassd）：在其 web/ 目录 npm run build（Node 17+ 需 NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider），构建后将根目录 index.html 与 dist/ 拷入本仓库 static/mindmap/
scripts.startosOnceComments: 开发环境-客户端（单次运行，配合 start 自动联动退出）
scripts.pre: shx rm -rf build && pnpm -C ./gui run build && run-script-os
scripts.pre:cef: shx rm -rf build && pnpm -C ./gui run build && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenvCEF\Scripts\python pyapp\spec\getSpec.py && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenvCEF\Scripts\pyinstaller --clean .\pyapp\spec\windows-pre-cef.spec
scripts.pre:folder: shx rm -rf build && pnpm -C ./gui run build && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\python pyapp\spec\getSpec.py && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\pyinstaller --clean .\pyapp\spec\windows-folder-pre.spec
scripts.prefoldercefComments: 预打包-cef模式-文件夹模式
scripts.pre:folder:cef: shx rm -rf build && pnpm -C ./gui run build && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenvCEF\Scripts\python pyapp\spec\getSpec.py && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenvCEF\Scripts\pyinstaller --clean .\pyapp\spec\windows-folder-pre-cef.spec
scripts.build: shx rm -rf build/* && shx rm -rf dist && pnpm -C ./gui run build && run-script-os && shx rm -rf dist && shx rm -rf build/cache
scripts.build:dmg: shx rm -rf build/*.dmg && ./pyapp/pyenv/bin/python pyapp/package/dmg/getDMG.py && cd ./build && ../pyapp/pyenv/bin/dmgbuild -s ../pyapp/package/dmg/dmg.py PPX PPX.dmg && shx rm -rf macos
scripts.build:windows: .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\python pyapp\spec\getSpec.py && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\pyinstaller --clean .\pyapp\spec\windows-folder.spec && shx rm -rf build/windows-folder && pnpm run build:exe
scripts.build:exe: shx rm -rf build/*_Windows.exe && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\python pyapp\package\exe\getIss.py && pyapp\package\exe\InnoSetup6\ISCC.exe pyapp\package\exe\InnoSetup.iss  && shx rm -rf build/windows
scripts.build:pure: shx rm -rf build && pnpm -C ./gui run build && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\python pyapp\spec\getSpec.py && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\pyinstaller --clean .\pyapp\spec\windows.spec && shx rm -rf build/windows && shx rm -rf build/cache
scripts.build:cef: shx rm -rf build && pnpm -C ./gui run build && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenvCEF\Scripts\python pyapp\spec\getSpec.py && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenvCEF\Scripts\pyinstaller --clean .\pyapp\spec\windows-cef.spec && pnpm run build:exe
scripts.build:folder: shx rm -rf build && pnpm -C ./gui run build && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\python pyapp\spec\getSpec.py && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\pyinstaller --clean .\pyapp\spec\windows-folder.spec && shx rm -rf windows-folder/
scripts.buildfoldercefComments: 正式打包-cef模式-文件夹模式
scripts.build:folder:cef: shx rm -rf build && pnpm -C ./gui run build && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenvCEF\Scripts\python pyapp\spec\getSpec.py && .\pyapp\pyenv\pyenvCEF\Scripts\pyinstaller --clean .\pyapp\spec\windows-folder-cef.spec
scripts.alembicComments: 迁移数据库(仅用于typeDB=sql)，用法: m=信息备注 pnpm run alembic
scripts.alembic:linux: cd ./pyapp/db/ && ../pyenv/bin/alembic revision --autogenerate -m "${m}" && ../pyenv/bin/alembic upgrade head && ../pyenv/bin/alembic upgrade head --sql > ../../static/db/migration.sql && ../pyenv/bin/alembic current > ../../static/db/version
scripts.alembic:macos: cd ./pyapp/db/ && ../pyenv/bin/alembic revision --autogenerate -m "${m}" && ../pyenv/bin/alembic upgrade head && ../pyenv/bin/alembic upgrade head --sql > ../../static/db/migration.sql && ../pyenv/bin/alembic current > ../../static/db/version
scripts.alembic:windows: cd ./pyapp/db/ && ..\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\alembic.exe revision --autogenerate -m "${m}" && ..\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\alembic.exe upgrade head && ..\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\alembic.exe upgrade head --sql > ..\..\static\db\migration.sql && ..\pyenv\pyenv\Scripts\alembic.exe current > ..\..\static\db\version
scripts.lintpyComments: Python 代码检查（Ruff，仅检查不修改；规则见 pyproject.toml）
scripts.lint: pnpm -C ./gui run lint && pnpm run lint:py
